pokedexEntries.rb: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

pokedexEntries.ye: It is said that this POKéMON lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, it is only a rumor.

pokedexEntries.go: It is said that this POKéMON constantly flies over the immense seas and rescues drowning people.

pokedexEntries.si: This marine POKéMON has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

pokedexEntries.cr: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

pokedexEntries.rs: DRAGONITE is capable of circling the globe in just sixteen hours. It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

pokedexEntries.fr: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

pokedexEntries.lg: Only a very few people ever see this POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

pokedexEntries.em: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

pokedexEntries.hg: It is said that this Pokémon constantly flies over the immense seas and rescues drowning people.

pokedexEntries.ss: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

pokedexEntries.oras: Dragonite is capable of circling the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

pokedexEntries.su: This Pokémon saved a shipwrecked man, taking him to a remote island—a paradise occupied solely by Dragonite.

pokedexEntries.mo: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it’s satisfied.

pokedexEntries.us: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship’s captain dubbed this Pokémon “the sea incarnate.”

pokedexEntries.um: You’ll often hear tales of this kindhearted Pokémon rescuing people or Pokémon that are drowning.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: It is said that this Pokémon lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, these are only rumors.

pokedexEntries.sw: It’s a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides wrecked ships to shore.
